display.label: Virtual Network Peering
display.description: Azure Virtual Network Peering for connecting virtual networks with high-bandwidth, low-latency communication

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Virtual Network Peering. Serves as the map key.

fields.label: Peering Name
fields.description: Name of the Virtual Network Peering. Must be 1-80 characters using alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens, and periods.

validation.pattern_error: Virtual Network Peering name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which the Virtual Network Peering should exist.

fields.label: Local Virtual Network Name
fields.description: The name of the local Virtual Network from which peering originates.

fields.label: Remote Virtual Network Resource ID
fields.description: The full Azure resource ID of the remote Virtual Network to be peered.

sections.label: Traffic and Gateway Settings
sections.description: Configure virtual network access, forwarded traffic, and gateway transit.

fields.label: Allow Virtual Network Access
fields.description: Controls whether VMs in the local virtual network can access VMs in the remote virtual network.

fields.label: Allow Forwarded Traffic
fields.description: Controls whether forwarded traffic from VMs in the remote virtual network will be allowed.

fields.label: Allow Gateway Transit
fields.description: Controls whether gateway links can be used in the remote virtual network's link to the local virtual network.

fields.label: Use Remote Gateways
fields.description: Controls if remote gateways can be used on the local virtual network. Requires allow_gateway_transit to be false.

fields.label: Peer Complete Virtual Networks
fields.description: Specifies whether the complete Virtual Network address space is peered. Set to false to enable subnet-specific peering.

fields.label: Local Subnet Names
fields.description: A list of local Subnet names that are Subnet peered with the remote Virtual Network.

fields.label: Remote Subnet Names
fields.description: A list of remote Subnet names from the remote Virtual Network that are Subnet peered.

fields.label: Only IPv6 Peering Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether only IPv6 address space is peered for Subnet peering.

sections.label: Triggers
sections.description: Custom triggers to force recreation on external changes.

fields.label: Triggers
fields.description: A mapping of key-value pairs that forces recreation of the peering when external dependencies change (e.g. remote address space).
